pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown contiguous regions exhibiting high-frequency serration and irregular, stellate perimeters. The geometry is non-smooth with numerous sharp projections into the light corridors. Relative spatial area of patches decreases from the mid-flank toward the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected topological graph of cream-colored pixels. Junction nodes are clearly defined as 3-way and 4-way intersections. The thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform, though minor pixel-level dilation occurs at junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the superior neck boundary, representing the mane's contrast against the background.
